description: Remind to load language/framework skills before editing code

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *.java) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: Have you loaded the tdder:java skill this session? If not, stop and invoke it before editing Java files."}}' ;; */pom.xml) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"REMINDER: Have you loaded the tdder:maven skill this session? If not, stop and invoke it before editing pom.xml."}}' ;; esac
